text: no bhante dhammā . cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya cakkhuṃ abhinivissa seyyohamasmīti vā hoti sadisohamasmīti vā hoti hīnohamasmīti vā hoti .pe. jivhāya sati .pe. manasmiṃ sati manaṃ upādāya manaṃ abhinivissa seyyohamasmīti vā hoti sadisohamasmīti vā hoti hīnohamasmīti vā hoti . taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ 1 sukhaṃ vāti . dukkhaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ
